exceptions.exact_route_or_component: apps/rayon_sports_tv / pairing and active session display
exceptions.varied_rule: Full TV home, detail, search, and content archetypes are not implemented.
exceptions.reason: The current native TV product is a venue display companion whose controlled purpose is pairing and showing an active session; content browsing would materially expand permissions, remote navigation, moderation, and distribution scope.
exceptions.approved_alternative: Time-bound display-only TV scope with pairing, active session, expiry, revocation, error, loading, focus, and recovery states.
exceptions.risk: Stakeholders may expect an independent consumer TV app; display-only scope can be misunderstood without store copy, operations controls, and accountable approval.
